title: Reproducible Sample Size Calculations with aiimsulator
text: Calculate complete recruitment targets using structured object. Get general equation, substitution report separately:
code:
library(aiimsulator) x <- ss_proportion(.50, .05, nonresponse = .10) x #> Single proportion: Wald normal precision #> Required analysable sample = 385; final recruitment target = 427. ss_table(x) #>             parameter    value #> 1                  n0 384.1459 #> 2 after_design_effect 384.1459 #> 3           after_fpc 384.1459 #> 4            complete 385.0000 #> 5         recruitment 427.0000 ss_equation(x, "formula", "text") #> [1] "n_0=\frac{Z_{1-\alpha/2}^{2}p(1-p)}{d^{2}}
n_{final}=\left\lceil\frac{n_0}{1-r}\right\rceil" ss_equation(x, "substituted_values", "text") #> [1] "n_0=\frac{1.95996^{2}\times0.5\times(1-0.5)}{0.05^{2}}=384.146
n_{final}=\left\lceil\frac{384.146}{1-0.1}\right\rceil=427" ss_report(x, formula = FALSE, substituted_values = FALSE,           results = TRUE, assumptions = TRUE, format = "text") #> [1] "Sample size result
Required analysable sample = 385; final recruitment target = 427.

Assumptions
Independent observations for the base formula; a normal approximation to the binomial distribution.
Precision is an absolute half-width on the proportion scale; relative precision is multiplied by anticipated p.
Design-effect inflation assumes an appropriate design variance model. SRS FPC assumes sampling without replacement.
All adjustments are performed before final upward rounding."

title: Reproducible Sample Size Calculations and Manuscript-Ready Equations
text: .qmd manuscript: included vignette inst/extdata/manuscript-example.qmd demonstrate format. software emits calculation report, study-specific rationale every input. Cite source literature used choose precision, prevalence, clinical margins, ICC anticipated effects separately.
code: ```{r} #| output: asis #| echo: false library(aiimsulator) result <- ss_proportion(p = .5, precision = .05, nonresponse = .1) cat(ss_report(result, formula = TRUE,               substituted_values = TRUE,               results = TRUE, format = "markdown")) ```  The recruitment target was `r result$n_final` participants.

title: Reproducible Sample Size Calculations and Manuscript-Ready Equations
text: Proportions means: normal/Wald planning explicit approximation warnings. Two independent groups: normal approximations; superiority, non-inferiority, equality TOST equivalence; one-sided alpha directional objectives. AUC: full ROC AUC Hanley-McNeil approximate variance, empirical DeLong pilot covariance, exact tests partial-AUC planning. Diagnostic: expected Wilson Wald precision, normal approximate benchmark tests. Joint endpoints use individual rather simultaneous CIs. Correlation: Pearson’s r uncorrected Fisher-z approximation, exact noncentral-t calculation, Spearman, repeated dependent correlations. Non-response: inflation applied upward rounding. calculation must reviewed sampling design, estimand, hypothesized effect, clinically meaningful margins feasibility. software validate study design automatically. GitHub Actions includes checks Linux, Windows macOS. source archive provided development archive, R CMD build product.
